tweet.text:
codex tip: set an automation that keeps your computer running smoothly. 

- kill all headless instances after test runs
- clear cache
- audit computer for further opportunities

This can be a Luna agent, it will cost you near nothing

This is the difference between my computer running at 100ºC and 40. Unusably laggy vs smooth as butter!
